subject: Security discovery: access history, RFI intake & log export plan
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Eve Sanders <eve.sanders@mediq.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-28T15:00:00Z
Subject: Security discovery: access history, RFI intake & log export plan

Hi Eve — thanks for taking the time on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Ask from MedIQ: sample admin/activity logs (admin role changes, API key usage, policy changes), exportable in CSV/JSON; confirmation of immutability/append-only behavior; SOC 2 Type II report or letter; completed vendor security questionnaire (RFI).
- What Redwood will provide: a 48-72 hour package with (1) a small sample export (admin events for last 7 days) attached, (2) link to our SOC 2 Type II letter, (3) answers to the questionnaire where we can. Full 30/90-day export and any signed paperwork on a slightly longer cadence (target by EOD Mar 4).
- Dependencies/asks for MedIQ: a prioritized list of fields you require in the export (timestamps, user id, action, resource, request_id) and indication if you need WORM/immutable chain proof for evidence.

I attached a small sample export to this thread for quick sanity-check. If that looks good I will queue the full export and have Karthik run the data pull; Neha will surface the SOC 2 artifacts.

Next steps (owners):
- Rachel: deliver sample export + SOC 2 link by EOD Feb 28 (done)
- Karthik: prepare full export (30/90 day slices) — target Mar 4
- Neha: surface SOC2 artifacts and signed attestation — target Mar 4
- Eve/MedIQ: confirm required fields and whether CSV/JSON acceptable

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on your side.

--
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126
From: Eve Sanders <eve.sanders@mediq.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedIQ Security Team <security@mediq.health>, procurement@mediq.health
Date: 2027-02-28T16:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Security discovery: access history, RFI intake & log export plan

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful and timely. We attached our standard security questionnaire (RFI) for Redwood to complete. A few clarifications from our side before we ingest the sample: 

1) For exports we need at minimum: timestamp (ISO8601), actor (internal user/email), action (create/update/delete/login), object/resource id, request_id, source IP.
2) Immutability: we need to understand whether exports are point-in-time snapshots backed by append-only storage or whether you support signed event chains. A written description is fine initially.
3) SOC 2: we require a current SOC 2 Type II report or an attestation letter. PDF or secure drive link OK.

Attached: MedIQ_RFI_Security_Questionnaire_20270228.pdf (fillable). Please populate the RFI where possible and return. For any gaps, flag acceptable compensating controls.

If you can get the full 30-day admin export by Mar 4 and return the RFI by then, procurement can move to contract redlines the following week.

Best,
Eve Sanders
Director, Security & Compliance | MedIQ Health
eve.sanders@mediq.health | +1 617-555-0189
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Eve Sanders <eve.sanders@mediq.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Security discovery: access history, RFI intake & log export plan

Eve — thanks, understood. Attached is a quick sample export for the last 7 days (redwood_log_sample_export.csv) containing the fields you requested. High-level notes included below: 

- Format: CSV with ISO8601 timestamps; columns: timestamp, actor_email, actor_id, action, resource_id, request_id, source_ip, user_agent
- Immutability: our control plane writes activity events to an append-only ledger for customer accounts; exports are point-in-time extracts from that ledger. We do not currently provide cryptographic signed event chains, but can document retention, WORM-backed storage options with Dedicated/Private customers as a compensating control.
- SOC 2: link to our latest SOC 2 Type II attestation: https://drive.redwood.inc/soc2/Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_letter.pdf

Next steps from Redwood: Karthik will kick off the full pull (30/90-day slices) and package a zipped export by EOD Mar 4. Neha will start filling the RFI and send back a completed copy + any gaps by Mar 4.

Attaching sample: redwood_log_sample_export.csv

Thanks — let us know if the sample schema needs adjustments.

--
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:45:00Z
Subject: Internal: action items for MedIQ RFI & exports

Karthik / Neha — quick internal note (forwarding the MedIQ thread below).

Karthik: please run the export job with these constraints: account=mediq-health, window=last 90 days (split to 30-day slices), include columns Eve listed, preserve request_id and source_ip. Produce both CSV and NDJSON output. Target: zipped deliverable by 2027-03-04 EOD. Confirm runtime estimate and if we need a maintenance window.

Neha: pull SOC2 artifacts and the signed attestation; complete the RFI where answers exist (I started a couple of sections). Flag any items we need legal or infra to sign off on. Target: Mar 4.

Cc: will notify Eve if any timelines slip.

Thanks — rachel
